text:
Tested with a single 30s Seedance generation.

Their agent rewrote my prompt into multiple shots automatically  then I did a quick edit pass.

This result came from one generation only. No retries.

Check out my boys at Medeo 👇 https://t.co/KzP16IzRIo
content: Use Seedance’s agent to automatically rewrite a single prompt into a multi-shot sequence, then do a quick manual edit pass on the shot list before generating to get a full 30s video in one run without retries.

translations.es:
Utiliza el agente de Seedance para reescribir automáticamente un único prompt en una secuencia de múltiples tomas, luego realiza una rápida revisión manual de la lista de tomas antes de generar para obtener un video completo de 30 segundos en una sola ejecución sin reintentos.
